facts.fact: The minister of Family, Social Action and Solidarities said at a workshop in Saly that each structure in the social sector has its own information system, which does not always allow data to be shared with other actors, and that a unified system is still to be built ahead of a planned single social window.
facts.system: Social protection information systems of the structures in the social sector
